senses.gloss: श्यैत॑ m. (also pl.), a patr. AV.; ĀśvŚr.
श्यैत॑ n. N. of a Sāman, ĀrṣBr.
श्यैन mfn. coming from a hawk &c. (see श्येन).
श्यैनम्पात mf(आ)n. (fr. श्येन-पात) any place fit for the flying of hawks (= श्येन-पातो ऽस्याम् वर्तते; with मृगया f. ‘hawking, hunting with hawks’), Pāṇ. iv, 2, 58, Sch.
श्यैनिक mfn. relating or belonging to the Ekāha Śyena, PañcavBr., Sch.
श्यैनेय॑ mfn. (fr. श्येनी) descended from a white cow, MaitrS.

श्यै cl. 1. P. श्यायति, to cause to congeal or freeze, ŚBr.;
 (Ā.) श्यायते (Gr. also pf. शश्ये; aor. अश्यास्त; fut. श्याता, श्यास्यते),
to go, move, Dhātup. xxii, 67 :
Pass. शीयते, to congeal, freeze, be cold, TS.; TBr. :
Caus. श्यापयति Gr.:
Desid. शिश्यासते, ib. :
Intens. शाश्यायते, शाश्येति, शाश्याति, ib.
